IlluminationSettings.description: Numerical parameters of horizon tracing and disc integration.

step_fraction.description: Ray sampling step in pixels of the level in use.
step_fraction.title: Step Fraction

near_radius_m.description: Ground distance out to which the site DEM is used.
near_radius_m.title: Near Radius M

mid_radius_m.description: Ground distance out to which the regional DEM is used.
mid_radius_m.title: Mid Radius M

far_coarsening.description: Block-averaging factor of the regional DEM beyond mid_radius_m.
far_coarsening.title: Far Coarsening

n_strips.description: Strips used to integrate the disc.

disc_mode.description: Horizon across the disc: per-strip profile, or one chord.
disc_mode.title: Disc Mode

MapBlock.description: Optional map of illumination statistics over a square window centred on the site.

n_azimuth.description: Horizon directions per pixel (cost is linear in it).
n_azimuth.title: N Azimuth

MapBlock.title: MapBlock

OrientedSurface.description:
A plane surface of an asset (panel, radiator, wall) at the site.

Only the direct solar irradiance on it and its sky and terrain view factors are
computed; its temperature depends on the asset and belongs in the asset's own thermal
model (HLS-UG-001 section 9).

tilt_deg.description: Angle from horizontal: 0 faces up, 90 is vertical.
tilt_deg.title: Tilt Deg

facing_azimuth_deg.description: Grid azimuth (from map +y towards +x) the surface faces.
facing_azimuth_deg.title: Facing Azimuth Deg

OrientedSurface.title: OrientedSurface

Period.description: Time span of the results, in UTC, sampled uniformly.

step_minutes.description: Sampling step of all time series.
step_minutes.title: Step Minutes

Period.title: Period

RegolithProperties.description: Parameters of the regolith model (defaults: Hayne2017, Table A1).

heat_capacity_coefficients.description: c0..c4 of c_p(T) in J kg-1 K-1
heat_capacity_coefficients.title: Heat Capacity Coefficients

albedo_quadratic_deg.description: c0, c1, c2 of an albedo quadratic in incidence angle in degrees, A = c0 + c1 i + c2 i^2 (Foote2020 form); replaces A0, a and b when set
albedo_quadratic_deg.title: Albedo Quadratic Deg

heat_capacity_model.description: c_p law: Hayne2017 polynomial (heat_capacity_coefficients) or the Woods-Robinson 2019 table of DSNE, polynomial above 300 K
heat_capacity_model.title: Heat Capacity Model

conductivity_model.description: contact-conductivity temperature law: Hayne2017 (constant) or the Woods-Robinson 2019 shape below 150 K (sensitivity option, review finding F09)
conductivity_model.title: Conductivity Model

RegolithProperties.title: RegolithProperties

Site.description:
Location of the point of interest.

Give either map coordinates (south polar stereographic metres, as in the LOLA
products) or longitude and latitude. ``terrain`` names the terrain data set that
covers the site.

terrain.description: Terrain set: 5 m site DEM plus regional DEM (see lunarenv.sites).
terrain.title: Terrain

height_above_surface_m.description: Height of the point above the terrain, for illumination and Earth visibility.
height_above_surface_m.title: Height Above Surface M

Site.title: Site

SlopeGrid.description:
Regolith temperature over a grid of ground slopes and aspects at the site.

The DEM slope at one point is uncertain by about 2 degrees (Barker2021), and at
grazing sunlight a few degrees of slope change the maximum by tens of kelvin. The
grid shows that sensitivity under each law of the albedo envelope.
SlopeGrid.title: SlopeGrid

SurfaceOrientation.description: Orientation of the surface element whose temperature is computed.

source.description: 'dem': slope of the terrain model at the site; 'explicit': values below.
source.title: Source

facing_azimuth_deg.description: Grid azimuth (from map +y towards +x) the surface faces.
facing_azimuth_deg.title: Facing Azimuth Deg

dem_baseline_m.description: Half-length over which the DEM slope is measured (default: one pixel).
dem_baseline_m.title: Dem Baseline M

SurfaceOrientation.title: SurfaceOrientation

constant_albedo_alternative.description: Also compute the result with a constant albedo. The incidence-dependent law was fitted on level equatorial ground; at grazing polar incidence the two differ by tens of kelvin. A constant 0.12 lies outside the published envelope on the hot side; against Diviner at the site it is +5.7 K (VALIDATION.md, TH-V3b).
constant_albedo_alternative.title: Constant Albedo Alternative

conductivity_alternative.description: Also compute the nominal case with the other low-temperature conductivity law (Woods-Robinson 2019 shape below 150 K, or Hayne2017's constant contact term) and report the change of the surface minimum and mean and of the means at depth (review finding F09, VALIDATION.md TH-C2).
conductivity_alternative.title: Conductivity Alternative

albedo_envelope.description: Also compute the surface temperature, with its uncertainty ensemble, under the cold (Bürger 2024) and hot (Foote 2020) bounds of the published albedo laws; the polar result is then reported as bounds, not as one nominal law (review change 2).
albedo_envelope.title: Albedo Envelope

slope_grid.description: Regolith temperature over ground slopes and aspects (nominal terrain).

oriented_surfaces.description: Asset surfaces: direct solar irradiance, sky / terrain view factors and, with terrain_radiation and earthshine, the diffuse irradiance on each.
oriented_surfaces.title: Oriented Surfaces

terrain_radiation.description: Add sunlight scattered by the surrounding terrain and its thermal emission, single bounce (review change 3; validated on the analytic bowl crater, TH-A3).
terrain_radiation.title: Terrain Radiation

earthshine.description: Add Earthshine, reflected and infrared (NASA HLS-UG-001 section 11.1).
earthshine.title: Earthshine

terrain_patch_refinement.description: Multiplies the number of azimuth sectors and distance bands of the terrain patches (1: 36 sectors, bands growing by sqrt(2) from 25 m).
terrain_patch_refinement.title: Terrain Patch Refinement

ThermalSettings.description: Numerical parameters of the thermal model (defaults: docs/convergence/thermal.md).
ThermalSettings.title: ThermalSettings

UncertaintyBlock.description: Monte Carlo propagation of terrain and regolith-parameter uncertainty.

terrain_clones.description: Terrain error clones to use, taken in catalog order from the cache.
terrain_clones.title: Terrain Clones

regional_error_k.description: Bound the illumination with the regional DEM raised and lowered by k times its rms height error (PGDA 90 error map, if cached); 0 disables.
regional_error_k.title: Regional Error K

UncertaintyBlock.title: UncertaintyBlock
